senses.gloss: कर्ण- + अञ्जलि कर्ण- + अञ्जलि, m. the auditory passage.
कर- + अवलम्बन कर- + अवलम्बन, n. taking hold with the hand, Śiś. 9, 82; Hit. 41, 16.
कर्मेन्द्रिय कर्मेन्द्रिय, i. e. कर्मन्-, n. an organ of action, e. g. the hand, foot, etc., Man. 2, 91.
करुणा- + उदय करुणा- + उदय, adj. causing compassion, MBh. 1, 436.
कर्मोपकरण कर्मोपकरण, i. e. कर्मन्-, adj. assisting by labour, Man. 10, 120.
कर्णोर्ण कर्णोर्ण, i. e. कर्ण-, adj. having wool near the ears, Bhāg. P. 4, 6, 21.
कर-कमल कर-कमल, n. a lotus-like hand, Ṛt. 3, 23.

कर कर, i. e. A कृ + अ,
 I. latter part of comp. adj. and subst., f. री, Making, causing, producing; e. g. वैर-, Causing enmity, Man. 9, 227.
 अ-यशस्-, Causing disgrace, Hiḍ. 3, 18.
 देह-, m. A father, MBh. 5, 3657.
 II. m.
 1. The hand, Man. 5, 136.
 2. An elephant's trunk, Nal. 13, 12.
 B. कॄ + अ, m.
 1. A ray of light, Rām. 6, 11, 44.
 2. Hail.
 3. Royal revenue, Man. 7, 128; toll, Man. 7, 127.
 --Comp.

1. कार कार, i. e. कृ + अ,
 I. adj., f. री. Latter part of a comp. adj. Making, a maker of, e. g. अन्ध-कार, माल-कार, रथ-कार.
 दन्त-, m. An artist in ivory, Rām. 2, 83, 14.
 द्यूत- (vb. दिव्) m. A gamester, Pañc. i. d. 431. []
 पर्व(न्)-, adj. Working at festivals.
 भस्म(न्)-, m. A washerman.
 सु-वर्ण-, स्वर्ण-, and हेम-, m. A goldsmith.
 II. m. Latter part of comp. substantives, Making action. Cf. e. g. काम-कार, पुरुष-कार; especially used after letters to form their name, e. g. अ-कार, the letter अ; उ-कार, the letter उ; म-कार, the letter म(म्), Man. 2, 76.
2. कार कार, i. e. कर + अ, adj. Produced by hail, Suśr. 1, 170, 1.
कारा कारा, f. A gaol, Daśak. in Chr. 198, 9.

करक करक, m., i. e.
 A. कृ + अक, The waterpot of the student or ascetic, Man. 4, 66.
 B. कॄ + अक, Hail, Megh. 55.

कारक कारक, i. e. कृ + अक,
 I. adj., f. रिका, Making. Latter part of nominal comps., e. g. क्षेम-, adj. Causing security, Pañc. v. d. 89.
 गृक-, m. A carpenter, Yājñ. 3, 146.
 प्रिय-, adj. Causing love, Man. 7, 204; गुरु-वचन-, adj. Performing the order of one's teacher; मङ्गल-, adj. Giving joy, MBh. 2, 1925; शिल्प-, adj. Versed in an art, Mālav. 65, 15.
 II. m. An agent; doing, Yājñ. 2, 233; causing, 3, 150; an author, MBh. 13, 247.
 सिंह-, m. A maker of lions, Pañc. v. d. 31.
 III. f. रिका, A metrical explanation, a memorial verse, MBh. 2, 453.
करकासार् करकासार्, a denominative derived from करक-आसार, Par. To rain like a shower of hail, Lass. 67, 16.
करङ्क करङ्क, m. The skull, Mālat. 79, 18.
करज कर-ज (vb. जन्), m. A finger nail, Man. 4, 70.
करञ्ज करञ्ज, m. The name of a plant, Pongamia glabra, Vent., MBh. 3, 14488 sqq.
करञ्जक करञ्ज + क, m. = the last, Rām. 3, 79, 37.

करट करट, m.
 1. An elephant's temples, MBh. 3, 16039; Bhartṛ. 3, 73.
 करटा-मुख, with lengthened अ, MBh. 3, 441, etc., perhaps on account of the metre.
 2. A crow, Bhāg. P. 5, 14, 29.
 3. pl. The name of a people, MBh. 6, 370.
 --Comp.

करटक करट + क, m.
 1. A crow, Mṛcch. 104, 13 (Prākṛ.).
 2. A proper name, Pañc. 9, 19.

करण करण, i. e. कृ + अन,
 I. adj., f. णी, Making, causing, e. g. वैधव्य-, Causing widowhood, Rām. 6, 95, 27.
 संजीव-, Causing health, Rām. 6, 26, 5.
 II. n.
 1. Making, MBh. 3, 15297; performing, Pañc. 40, 15.
 2. Action, Rām. 1, 11, 17.
 3. Instrument, Bhāṣāp. 57.
 4. An organ of sense, Ragh. 8, 38.
 5. The body, Kumāras. 4, 5.
 6. A document, Man. 8, 51. []
 7. Musical time, Kumāras. 6, 40.
 III. m. The son of a Vrātya Kṣatriya, Man. 10, 22.
 --Comp.

कारण कारण, i. e. कृ, Caus., + अन.
 I. m.
 1. Motive, Pañc. iii. d. 99.
 2. Cause, Suśr. 1, 310, 4; Kathās. 3, 31 (with the loc.).
 3. Primary cause, Man. 5, 152; Bhartṛ. 2, 82.
 4. An element, Yājñ. 3, 148.
 5. Basis, Man. 11, 84.
 6. Argument, Nal. 16, 27; proof, Man. 8, 200.
 7. An instrument, a means, Rām. 1, 65, 10 (cf. Gorr. 1, 67, 4, who reads उपायैः).
 8. An organ of sense, Ragh. 16, 22.
 9. Abl. कारणात्, and loc. णे, On account of, Rām. 5, 56, 136; 5, 28, 9. Instr. णेन, By some reason, Cāṇ. 23.
 येन कारणेन, Because, Pañc. 175, 10.
 किं पुनः कारणम्, From what motive, MBh. 1, 3600.
 II. f. णा, Torture, Daśak. in Chr. 195, 16.
 --Comp.
करण्ड करण्ड, m. and n. ( Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 392), A basket or covered box of wicker work, Bhartṛ. 2, 82.

करण्डक करण्ड + क, m. A box Śāk. 89, 15 (Prākṛ.).
 --Comp.
करतोया करतोया, i. e. कर-तोय, f. The name of a river, MBh. 2, 374.
करतोयिनी करतोयिनी, i. e. कर-तोय + इन् + ई, f. The name of a river, MBh. 12, 4887.

करद कर-द (vb. दा), adj.
 1. Paying taxes, MBh. 1, 7170.
 2. Tributary, 3, 15288.
करंधम करंधम, i. e. कर + म्-ध्मा + अ, m. A proner name, MBh. 14, 78.

कारंधम कारंधम, i. e. करंधम + अ, patron.
 I. m. MBh. 14, 63.
 II. n. The name of a holy place, MBh. 1, 7843.
करपाल कर-पाल, करबाल करबाल, and करवाल करवाल (with ब्, व् for प्), m. A sword, MBh. 1, 1432.
करप्रद कर-प्र-द (vb. दा), adj. Tributary, MBh. 3, 14774.
करबाल करबाल, see करपाल.

करभ कर-भ (vb. भा), m.
 1. [] The metacarpus, the hand from the wrist to the root of the fingers, MBh. 3, 16138.
 2. An elephant's trunk, Ragh. 6, 83.
 3. A young elephant, Bhāg. P. 8, 2, 22.
 4. A young camel, Pañc. 229, 5.
 5. A camel, MBh. 2, 1200.
करभक करभ + क, m. A proper name, Śāk. 29, 15.

करमर्द करमर्द, i. e. कर-मृद् + अ,
 I. m. A small acanthaceous tree, Carissa carandas, Lin., MBh. 1, 11571.
 II. n. Its fruit, Suśr. 1, 210, 18.
करम्ब करम्ब, m. = करम्भ, q. cf.
करम्बित करम्बित, i. e. करम्ब + इत, adj. Mingled, Gīt. i. 27.

करम्भ करम्भ,
 I. m.
 1. A cake of flour or meal mixed with curds, Man. 12, 76.
 2. Mixture, Bhāg. P. 3, 26, 45 (a mixed smell).
 3. A proper name, Rām. 4, 39, 35.
 II. f. भा, A proper name, MBh. 1, 3775.
 --Cf. perhaps κάραβος, ἔδεσμα ὠπτημένον ἐπ’ ἀνθράκων.
करम्भक करम्भ + क, m. A cake, Rājat. 5, 16.
कररुह कर-रुह् + अ, m. A finger nail, Megh. 94.

करवीर कर-वीर, m.
 1. A fragrant plant, Oleander or Nerium odorum, Rām. 3, 17, 10.
 2. The name of a magical weapon, Rām. 1, 30, 7.
 3. The name of a Nāga, MBh. 1, 1557.
 4. The name of a mountain, Bhāg. P. 5, 16, 28.
 5. The name of a city, MBh. 13, 1730.
करस्थालिन् करस्थालिन्, i. e. कर-स्थाल + इन्, m. A name of Śiva, MBh. 13, 1243.
करायिका करायिका, f. A small kind of crane, Pañc. 157, 3.

कराल कराल, adj., f. ला,
 1. Gaping, [] Mṛcch. 47, 2.
 2. Formidable, Hiḍ. 2, 5; MBh. 2, 296.
 II. m.
 1. A certain beast, Suśr. 1, 200, 8.
 2. The name of a locality, Rājat. 1, 97.
 III. f. ला, A name of Durgā, Mālat. 75, 6.
 --Comp.
करालता कराल + ता, f. Formidableness, Pañc. 217, 23, ˚तां गतः, It became formidable.

करिन् करिन्, i. e. कर + इन्,
 I. m. An elephant, Kir. 5, 7.
 II. f. इणी, A female elephant, Bhartṛ. 3, 82.
 --Comp.

कारिन् कारिन्, i. e. क्रि + इन्, adj., f. इणी, An agent, Rām. 2, 78, 8; MBh. 13, 4804; acting, Man. 7, 26.
 --It is generally [] the latter part of a comp. adj., e. g. अ-कार्य-, adj.
 1. One who does a wrong action, Man. 11, 239.
 2. One who does not what ought to be done, i. e. who neglects his duty, Man. 5, 107.
 अ-क्लिष्ट-, adj. Indefatigable, Rām. 3, 31, 1.
 आप्त-, adj. Acting properly, Man. 9, 12 (in a trustworthy manner).
 केश-, m. f. इणी, A hair-dresser, MBh. 4, 412.
 क्षिप्र-, adj. Clever, Rām. 3, 36, 10.
 गृह-, m. A kind of wasp. Man. 12, 66.
 तत्कर्मकारिन्, i. e. तद्-कर्मन्-, adj. Doing the same, Man. 9, 261.
 दृढ-, adj. Persevering in good actions, Man. 4, 246.
 विघ्न-, adj.
 1. Obstructing.
 2. Fearful.

करीर करीर,
 I. m. and n. The shoot of a bamboo, Suśr. 1, 28, 6.
 II. m. A leafless plant, Capparis aphylla, Roxb., Bhartṛ. 2, 89.

करीष करीष, i. e. कॄ + ईष, m. and n.
 1. Dry dung, Rām. 2, 100, 7; 3, 3, 2.
 2. Dry cow-dung, Man. 8, 250.

कारीष कारीष, i. e. करीष + अ,
 I. adj. Sprung up from dung, Suśr. 1, 224, 11.
 II. n. A great quantity of dung, Hariv. 4355.

करुण करुण,
 I. adj., f. णा,
 1. Doleful, Vikr. 4, 1; Rām. 2, 63, 32.
 2. Lamentable, Rām. 3, 51, 25.
 II. णम् (acc. sing. n.), adverbially, Miserably, Rām. 1, 2, 14; Śiś. 9, 67.
 III. m. Moving compassion, one of the रसस्, or sentiments of a poetical production, Rām. 1, 4, 7.
 IV. f. णा, Compassion, Bhāg. P. 1, 2, 3.
 --Comp.
करुणवेदिता करुणवेदिता, i. e. करुण-वेदिन् + ता, f. Benignity of heart, Man. 7, 211.
करुणाय करुणाय, a denom. derived from करुण by य, Ātm., but in epic poetry also Par. To be in distress, MBh. 3, 336 (Par.).
करुणावन्त् करुणा + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Distressed, Rām. 5, 33, 14.

करूष करूष, m. pl. The name of a people, MBh. 2, 124; Rām. 1, 26, 20.
 --Comp.
कारुष कारुष, m. The offspring of a Vrātya, or an outcast of the Vaiśya tribe, Man. 10, 23.

कारूष कारूष, m.
 1. The name of a country, MBh. 2, 1864.
 2. pl. Its people, Bhāg. P. 9, 2, 16.
 3. Its king, Hariv. 4954.

करूषक करूष + क,
 I. m. A proper name.
 II. n. A certain fruit, MBh. 3, 10039.
कारूषक कारूष-क, adj. Belonging to the Kārūṣas, MBh. 1, 2700.

करेणु करेणु (base कर),
 I. m. f. A male or female elephant, MBh. 13, 4899; 1, 4477.
 II. m. The name of a plant, Suśr. 2, 171, 16.

करेणुक करेणु + क,
 I. n. The fruit of the plant करेणु.
 II. f. का, A female elephant, Pañc. 43, 5.

करोट करोट,
 I. m. A basin; probably also cymbals in टक्कराघातसटांकारकरोटिकाः Rājat. 5, 417.
 II. m., and f. टा and टी, The skull, Rājat. 6, 157.
कर्क कर्क, m. A white horse, MBh. 13, 4921.

कर्कट कर्कट, a form of *कर्कर्त, i. e. an old reduplicated form of कृत् + अ,
 I. m.
 1. A crab, Pañc. iv. d. 10.
 2. The sign of the zodiac, Cancer, Rām. 1, 19, 2.
 3. The name of a plant, Suśr. 2, 253, 12.
 II. f. टी, A female crab, MBh. 4, 272.
 III. m., f. टी, The curved end of the beam of a balance, Pañc. ii. d. 74.
 --Cf. Lat. cancer; καρκίνος.

कर्कटक कर्कट + क,
 I. m.
 1. A crab, Pañc. 1, 237.
 2. The name of a plant, Suśr. 2, 527, 4.
 3. The name of a Nāga, Rām. 5, 78, 9.
 II. f. की, A [] female crab, Draup. 5, 9.
 III. n. A poisonous bulbous plant, Suśr. 2, 252, 7.
कर्कटिका कर्कटिका, i. e. कर्कट + क, f. The name of a plant, probably a sort of cucumber, Pañc. 248, 2.

कर्कन्धु कर्कन्धु,
 I. m., and f. धू, The jujube, Zizyphus jujuba.
 II. n. Its fruit, Yājñ. 1, 240; also the fem. धू, Bhāg. P. 3, 31, 32.
 III. m. A proper name, Chr. 296, 6 = Rigv. i. 112, 6.

कर्कर कर्कर,
 I. adj., f. रा, Hard, Mālat. 79, 18.
 II. m. The name of a Nāga, MBh. 1, 1561.
 III. f. री, A small water-jar, Bhartṛ. 1, 47.
 --Cf. perhaps Lat. calculus, calx; κρόκη, κροκάλη, κάχληξ.

कर्कश कर्कश, adj., f. शा.
 1. Hard, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 740.
 2. Firm, Bhartṛ. 2, 56.
 3. Cruel, Rām. 3, 36, 23.

कर्कशत्व कर्कश + त्व, n.
 1. Hardness, Kumāras. 1, 36.
 2. Harshness, MBh. 13, 542.

कर्कोटक कर्कोटक,
 I. m.
 1. The name of a Nāga or snake, Nal. 14, 4.
 2. A plant, Momordica mixta, Suśr. 1, 137, 15.
 II. n. Its fruit, 2, 343, 1.
† कर्ज् कर्ज्, i. 1, Par. To pain or make uneasy.

† कर्ण् कर्ण्, i. 10, Par. To pierce or bore.
 --Cf. आकर्णय.

कर्ण कर्ण, m.
 1. The ear, Man. 8, 125; with दा, To listen, Śāk. 8, 21.
 2. A rudder, Rām. 6, 23, 30.
 3. A proper name, MBh. 1, 2427.
 --Comp.
 When the latter part of a comp. adj. the f. ends in णा and णी.
कर्णकुब्ज कर्ण-कुब्ज, n. The name of a city, Lass. 8, 9.
कर्णग्राहवन्त् कर्णग्राहवन्त्, i. e. कर्ण-ग्रह् + अ + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Having a helmsman, Rām. 2, 52, 5.

कर्णधार कर्णधार, i. e. कर्ण-धृ + अ, m. A helmsman, Rām. 2, 52, 75.
 --Comp.
कर्णवन्त् कर्ण + वन्त्, adj. f. वती, Having ears, Rām. 2, 45, 15.
कर्णश्रव कर्णश्रव, i. e. कर्ण-श्रु + अ, adj. Heard by the ear, Man. 4, 102.
कर्ण- + श्रव कर्ण- + श्रव, adj. perceivable by the ear, Man. 4, 102.
कर्णाकर्णि कर्णाकर्णि, i. e. कर्ण-कर्ण + इ, adv. From ear to ear, Rām. 6, 21, 39.

कर्णाट कर्णाट,
 I. m. pl. The name [] of a country and its inhabitants, MBh. 3, 16352.
 II. f. टी, A proper name, Rājat. 4, 152.
कर्णाटक कर्णाट + क = कर्णाट, m. Bhāg. P. 5, 6, 8.

कर्णिका कर्णिका, i. e. कर्ण + क or इक, f.
 1. An ornament of the ear, Daśak. in Chr. 199, 1.
 2. The pericarp of the lotus, Rām. 3, 22, 25.
 3. The name of an Apsaras, MBh. 1, 428.
 --Comp.

कर्णिकार कर्णिकार,
 I. m. The name of a plant, Pterospermum acerifolium, Rām. 3, 21, 15.
 II. n. Its flower, Ṛt. 6, 6.

कर्णिन् कर्णिन्, i. e. कर्ण + इन्, adj.
 1. Mischievously barbed, Man. 7, 90.
 2. In -अर्धकुण्डलकर्णिन्, MBh. 13, 886, where the aff. इन् belongs to -अर्ध-कुण्डल-कर्ण, not to कर्ण alone: Wearing in his ear half an ear-ring.
कर्णीरथ कर्णीरथ (cf. रथ), m. A litter, Rājat. 5, 218.
कर्णीसुत कर्णीसुत (cf. सु), m. A proper name, Daśak. in Chr. 185, 16.
कर्णोपकर्णिका कर्णोपकर्णिका, i. e. कर्ण-उप-कर्ण + क, f. Gossip, Pañc. 36, 19.
† कर्त् कर्त्, see कर्त्र्.
कर्तन कर्तन, i. e. कृत् + अन, n. Cutting, Yājñ. 2, 229.
कर्तव्यता कर्तव्य + ता (vb. कृ), f. Business, Man. 7, 61.
कर्तुकाम कर्तुकाम, i. e. कर्तुम्-काम (vb. कृ), adj. Desiring to do, Rām. 3, 49, 51.
कर्तुमनस् कर्तुमनस्, i. e. कर्तुम्-मनस् [] (vb. कृ), adj. Intending to do, Pañc. 12, 19.

कर्तृ कर्तृ, i. e. कृ + तृ, m., f. त्री, and n.
 1. An agent, a maker, Rām. 4, 24, 5; Man. 4, 172; 3, 160; 5, 105 (n.); Kathās. 25, 153 (f.).
 2. A founder, MBh. 13, 1662.
 3. Creator, Rām. 3, 69, 7.
 4. An author, Pañc. ii. d. 34.
 --Comp.
ऽकर्तृक -कर्तृ + क, a substitute for कर्तृ, when the latter part of a comp. adj., e. g. स-, adj., f. का, Accompanied by an agent, Bhāṣāp. 46.
कर्तृत्व कर्तृ + त्व, n. Being agent, MBh. 3, 1232.
कर्त्तरि and री कर्त्तरी̆ (for कर्त्त्री, i. e. कृत् + तृ + ई), f. Scissors, Suśr. 2, 13, 16.
† कर्त्र् कर्त्र्, or कर्त् कर्त्, or कत्र् कत्र्, i. 10, Par. To loosen (akin to कृत्, a denominative).

कर्त्त्रिका कर्त्त्रिका, i. e. 1. कृत् + तृ + ई + क, f. A hunter's knife, Hit. 43, 19 v. r.
 --With कर्त्तृ, cf. Lat. culter.
† कर्द् कर्द्, i. 1, Par. To grumble, as the bowels.

कर्दम कर्दम,
 I. m.
 1. Mud, Yājñ. 1, 197; Rām. 3, 78, 31 (रुधिरकर्दम, Gore, Pañc. iii. d. 107).
 2. Dregs, MBh. 14, 2683.
 3. A certain plant, Suśr. 2, 100, 20.
 4. The name of a Nāga, MBh. 1, 1561; of a Prajāpati, 12, 2211.
 II. adj. Soiled, Suśr. 2, 309, 5.
 --Comp.

कार्दम कार्दम, i. e. कर्दम + अ, adj.
 1. Muddy, Rām. 5, 27, 16.
 2. Belonging to the Prajāpati Kardama, Bhāg. P. 3, 24, 6.
कर्पट कर्पट (this and some of the following words seem to be derived from a base कर्प् = Lat. carpo), m. and n. Rags, Pañc. 236, 25.
कर्पण कर्पण (see the last), A spear, Daśak. 56, 17.

कर्पर कर्पर (see कर्पट), n.
 1. A pot, Pañc. 218, 11.
 2. A potsherd, Pañc. 217, 22.
 --Comp.
कर्पास कर्पास (see कर्पट), m. and n. Cotton, Suśr. 2, 481, 13.

कार्पास कार्पास, i. e. कर्पास + अ,
